checks: the output is exactly one JSON object with the schema fields and allowed values
each event lasts at least 60 ms after the gaps are removed
the waveform differs from every committed motif
the feature distance to every committed motif is at least task.separation_threshold

codes.E_DOMAIN: a value is not an allowed value
codes.E_DUPLICATE: the waveform equals an existing motif
codes.E_EVENT_SHORT: an event is shorter than 60 ms
codes.E_JSON: the output is not exactly one JSON object
codes.E_RESERVED: the motif collides with a reserved signal
codes.E_SCHEMA: a field is missing, extra or of the wrong type
codes.E_SEPARATION: the feature distance to an existing motif is below the threshold

feedback_fields.association: 1-7: ease of associating the candidate with its meaning
feedback_fields.distinguishability: 1-7: distinguishability from the nearest committed motif (4 by rule for the first atom)
feedback_fields.eligible: valid and rated comfort acceptable by at least 2 raters
feedback_fields.incumbent_slot_index: the best eligible candidate so far
feedback_fields.same_round: earlier proposals of the current round (not rated yet)

gaps_ms.description: Silence after event 1 and after event 2, in milliseconds.

pitches.description: Semitone offset of each event from the profile base frequency.

rhythm_weights.description: Relative share of (total_ms - gaps) given to each event.

total_ms.description: Motif length in milliseconds, including both gaps.
